display_name: 解析自由截距残差LocalRidge与support监督adapter联合适应注册
description: 保留旧类核尺度、实际B函数先验和函数坐标adapter，以带解析自由类截距的残差LocalRidge经完整隐式梯度联合训练；保留完整interaction，不做参数网格。
authorization: Existing user joint LocalRidge/target-support SFT authorization; root sole launch owner.

code.commit_note: Preparation parent; publisher records actual pushed release commit in launch/startup.

data.dataset: Support slices only from the two existing VALIDATED_ONCE capsules
data.representation: Existing immutable support-only z_id/fft/t_emb/f_emb/pa_local; same single received observation
data.split_id: Explicit selected 40 support splits per cohort; complete original producer matrix retained
data.validation_ref: Existing cohort capsule manifests; no data rebuild or revalidation
data.support_query_ref: Only registered support_indices/support_labels are consumed; query excluded
data.reuse_policy: VALIDATED_ONCE; runtime artifact identity/binding checks only, no new data validation

permissions.truth_use: Legal inner-held support labels supervise adapter; outer-held labels only score frozen predictions; no query

checkpoint.initialization: Exact source-only scratch final200 model; eval and frozen; no changed buffers or weights
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two smallest fixed source model seeds, final200, selected from metadata before results
checkpoint.inheritance_policy: Only original source-only model; no historical adapted head/cache state
checkpoint.current_auxiliary_training: Fixed compliant source-only encoder caches; no checkpoint loaded; only at most736r<=5888 current target-support AffineJL Z coordinates trained; fixed V0; U materialized; no historical adapted state
checkpoint.feature_cache_producer_role: support-only raw frozen features; no learned state

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; two lanes with two BLAS threads each; no encoder/checkpoint loading
execution.stop_rule: Technical failure fails only its lane; healthy lanes finish. No automatic retry, no stopping for weak support diagnostics.

notes: Only R0 and declared R_AFFINE_seq are compared; no reset candidate or parameter search.
Same 160 physical support parents; old6; new0/2/5/10/20; K1/5/10/20; practical residual/post_sync/noeq/25MHz.
True K1 and proxy trainK1 have no adapter supervision but still fit complete B/C closed heads; their unavailable held accuracy remains N/A.
Fold-local old inner-train raw support supplies fixed tau/gamma; no nuisance head or solve. Old reference physical measure is fixed, but reference embeddings follow current U.

B prior is zero; C final prior is the actual B function padded with new zero columns. Each C inner prior head refits only old inner-train at frozen actual U_B, with no nested B training. C-inner holdout supervision is legal training, not independent validation.
C inherits actual U_B exactly and trains Z in new current-support coordinates; m is fixed in the C gradient, including its actual B kernel parameters. new0 exactly reuses B state and scores.

Row/class-centered targets Y; E=Y-m without second sample centering. Joint Schur solve gives (K+I)alpha+1*intercept=E and 1^T alpha=0; intercept is unpenalized and learned analytically from legal train support. Residual g is regularized, actual B prior fixed.

Per-class mean CE then class RMS plus 0.5||Z||^2; complete intercept adjoint includes g_b=sum_rows(G), with all centered-kernel paths consistent. No keep channel, manually tuned group offset, temperature or accuracy selection.
Four normalized function-coordinate iterations, at most twelve bounded halving trials per iteration, initial step0.125; first actual Armijo/nonincrease trial accepted, no outer or query feedback.
Rank-zero or noninformative old kernel retains anchor but still closes the head; no new-support bandwidth fallback, floor or jitter. Nonfinite/unrepresentable arithmetic is technical failure.
A unavailable in this support pilot; B0/R0 cannot substitute ground A. No direct promotion or independent-data claim.

Function anchoring is empirical regularized continuation, not exact sequential Bayes or an old-accuracy guarantee. The free intercept removes the forced old-reference mean restriction, without guaranteeing accuracy improvement; q gauge equivalence requires identical raw kernels/scales/U/support/actual prior.
Source-only encoder cache remains fixed; no encoder/checkpoint loaded, source samples, source per-record features or ground summaries. Additional ground summary transmission0 bytes.

At most736r<=5888 trainable function coordinates; dictionary width8, retained r measured. Actual training/inference times, RSS/state bytes and all head/solve/distance counts reported; satellite/GPU unmeasured=N/A.

Primal affine solves have C+1 RHS while CE adjoints have C RHS, counted with actual n and all rejected trials; dense work units are a dimensional proxy, not measured FLOP. Intercept state and Schur caches are charged separately from adapter coordinates. Detailed text/full numeric NPZ/compact JSONL/CSV retained.

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Held legal support predictions only; no query
metrics_plan.interpretation: Complete paired support-only joint pilot; inner loss is supervised training, outer support holdout is performance; no query claim.

probe.proxy_policy: All sorted positions 0..parent_K-1 inside each current support set; true K1 excluded
